name: Karma
source:
You have almost forgotten about it. A past humiliation where you long since have moved on.

But suddenly, like heaven sent, you got the chance for vengeance. Will you take it and succed, or will you be the bigger man? or will you...

Going down the path of getting even is always dangerous. Be careful.

[From [url=https://powerplower.com]Official site[/url]]
